newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, focus on Sentul.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed, focus on Sentul.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen mixed on Monday, with the focus seen on Bukit Sentul as the property firm is scheduled to be listed today, brokers said.
They said Sentul was likely to be the market focus for the whole day due partly to its attractive initial offer price of 500 rupiah.
"Overall trading is likely to stay slow as players would remain on the sidelines waiting for further developments in the volatile currency markets," one broker said.
Brokers said bargain-hunting was likely in stocks which fell sharply last week due to market talk of poor first half earnings.
"Some of the sell-offs such as in Darya Varia was rather overdone, I think Darya should offer a bargain to courageous investors," the broker said.
Brokers, however, said sentiment was likely to remain on Tambang Timah after announcement of poor first half results and expected continued weak tin prices.
On Friday, the Jakarta composite index ended 1.99 points, or 0.28 percent, lower at 710.06 points.

"With some 400 million shares offered to the public, the share price is unlikely to be traded above the 700 rupiah levels as it would be difficult to push up the price," one broker said. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
